correctness.rationale: For coordinate subspaces, multiplication is exactly controlled by common natural-basis support. Under the functional-square hypothesis every nonzero square has a single target, so all ordinary powers remain coordinate subspaces and satisfy an exact support recurrence. Induction on incoming path depth proves both directions of \(e_v\in E^k\iff k\le2^{\ell(v)}\). The boundary cases \(L=0\) and arbitrary characteristic are included. An independent exhaustive reconstruction over all 18,248 acyclic partial functional digraphs on at most six vertices matched the formula, but the finite check is only corroboration.

value.rationale: The result turns a qualitative graph criterion into a complete closed-form ordinary-power filtration for a natural structural subclass. It simultaneously gives every power dimension and the exact nilpotency index, handles branching and disconnected functional forests uniformly, and shows precisely when nonzero edge weights are irrelevant. This is a structural lemma rather than a parameter tweak or finite census; it identifies a reusable graph-to-algebra invariant and recovers the classical maximal-index chain as a sharp boundary case.
